title: Can AI *remember* you?
analogy: A fresh notepad each chat, unless it keeps a sticky note.

steps.name: New chat, blank
steps.desc: Each chat starts fresh. Old chats are not read.

steps.name: Saves a few notes
steps.desc: Memory on: it keeps short facts, like your job or tone.

steps.name: Reads them first
steps.desc: Next time, it checks those notes before it answers.
